title: Too short
text: Too short. I was disappointed that this item was so much smaller than it appears in the description. Sadly I had to return it. If it had been longer I would have been a lot happier with it.

product_metadata.title: Taymor (02-D1087) Chrome Soap and Sponge Bathtub Caddy
features: Fits Standard or Claw footed tubs
Comes with protective vinyl coated grips to prevent scratching of the tub surface.
Material: Made from Plated Steel and Manufacturing Source: Imported
Wipe with a clean damp cloth, do not use abrasives.
description: This bath caddy is so quaint that you may want to take it with you on vacation. This no fuss caddy has a place for your soap and bath sponge just the items you need during a stay at your favorite Bed and Breakfast.
